subject.title: fix(agents): adopt orphaned managed worktrees left by a crash between git worktree add and registry insert

question: Should managed worktrees gain persisted provisioning readiness before this PR merges, or should claim-early registration be replaced with another owner-safe recovery design?
rationale: The final proof confirms that a claim-time row can survive a crash and be returned as active while setup is incomplete; selecting the permanent persisted lifecycle and migration requires feature-owner judgment.

options.title: Add readiness state
options.body: Add a SQLite-backed provisioning/ready state, migrate existing rows as ready, and gate usable-record paths on readiness.

options.title: Replace claim-early registration
options.body: Retain post-provision live records and use another atomic ownership mechanism that cannot be mistaken for a usable worktree.

recommendation.title: Add readiness state
recommendation.body: Add a SQLite-backed provisioning/ready state, migrate existing rows as ready, and gate usable-record paths on readiness.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the managed worktree lifecycle and its storage, gateway, CLI, UI, and plugin-runtime contracts.
